reasoning: This repository provides a collection of detector microservices for the FMS Guardrails Orchestrator. It contains three distinct detectors (huggingface, llm_judge, builtIn), each packaged as a container image via its own Dockerfile and exposing HTTP APIs (on ports 8000/8080) for text content detection. The detectors are designed to be deployed as KServe inference services with accompanying ServingRuntime and InferenceService manifests. The project's purpose is to run as standalone microservices that receive text content and return detection results — a clear service classification.
